messages:
dalia: Quick sync after the postmortem. Need owners for remediation + test additions for the KV tail: regression cases, curated prompt vectors, load profiles, and a chaos drill.

harry: I can take the regressions and CI wiring. Plan: add 50 targeted regression cases that reproduce hot-key tail behavior and hook them into canary. ETA: PR by 2025-04-25.

noah: Ill own prompt vectors and baselines. Will curate 90 vectors (sanitized real sessions + synthetic high-skew keys) and include expected metrics. Storing at tests/promptsets/kv-tail-2025.json. PR by 2025-04-24.

dalia: Who owns load profile and chaos? We want two load patterns (sustained medium load + short rapid spike) and a replica-isolate chaos scenario.

noah: I can sketch the load k6 jobs. Proposed: steady 220rps for 30m, spike 100->850rps over 3m hold 7m. Will add metrics capture for per-key kv_hit_rate and p99/p999.

harry: Chaos harness outline (will use safe tooling, no iptables):
```
# chaos plan (sketch)
run_load(profile="rapid_spike", rps=[100,850], duration=600)
wait(20)
isolate_replica(tag="replica-c", duration=30)
observe(["kv_hit_rate","p99_latency","errors"])
abort_if(p99 > 500ms or errors > 0.5%)
```
Will add dry-run flag and explicit abort steps.

dalia: CI gating: gate on absolute SLAs and relative regressions. Proposal: p99 < 130ms, p999 < 320ms, kv-miss delta < 7% vs baseline. Canary should block deploys on violations. Nightly full reg-suite and quick smoke on PRs.

ci-bot: Noted. Creating ticket to track owners/timelines and will post job templates for canary + nightly.

harry: Also adding perf-budget labels to PRs so reviewers see potential regressions. Will include rollback playbook link in PR description.

noah: Ill include per-vector expected kv_hit_rate and latency in the promptset JSON so CI can compare automatically.

dalia: Add alerts: page oncall if canary fails a deploy; if nightly fails 3x in a row, auto-create follow-up incident. Also add a short exec summary to the ticket.

ops-bot: Created TICKET-5119: "KV tail remediation and test additions" assigned to harry,noah,dalia due 2025-04-30.

harry: Will open WIP PRs today and tag reviewers. noah: will post promptset and baseline capture instructions.

dalia: Thanks 44d Keep updates short in TICKET-5119."
